harness.source:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# S22 independent test runner for tools/souji-verify.sh (round 2, souji-shokunin).
# Read-only against every live tree. Mutating git verbs are confined to fixture
# repos created under mktemp -d in /tmp. Emits a TSV of check results to $1.
# Env: TOOL=<path under test> (default lane tools/souji-verify.sh), TOOL_TIMEOUT.
set -euo pipefail

REPO=/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/souji-shokunin
TOOL="${TOOL:-$REPO/tools/souji-verify.sh}"
TSV="${1:?usage: verify-runner.sh <results.tsv>}"
T="${TOOL_TIMEOUT:-120}"
SAFE_PATH="$PATH"
export GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=t GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=t@t GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=t GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=t@t
W="$(mktemp -d /tmp/souji-s22-w.XXXXXX)"
SHIM="$W/shim"; mkdir -p "$SHIM"
GITLOG="$W/git-verbs.log"; : > "$GITLOG"
cat > "$SHIM/git" <<EOF
#!/usr/bin/env bash
printf '%s\t%s\n' "\$PWD" "\$*" >> "$GITLOG"
sub=""; skip=0
for a in "\$@"; do
  if [[ "\$skip" == "1" ]]; then skip=0; continue; fi
  case "\$a" in
    -C|-c|--git-dir|--work-tree|--namespace|--exec-path) skip=1; continue ;;
    -*) continue ;;
  esac
  sub="\$a"; break
done
case "\$sub" in
  fetch|push|commit|checkout|reset|rebase|branch) echo "S22-SHIM: blocked forbidden verb: git \$*" >&2; exit 99 ;;
esac
exec /usr/bin/git "\$@"
EOF
chmod +x "$SHIM/git"

: > "$TSV"
san() { printf '%s' "$1" | tr '\n' ' ' | sed -e 's/\t/ ; /g'; }
rec() { # id name expect observed pass cmd [note]
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$(san "$1")" "$(san "$2")" "$(san "$3")" "$(san "$4")" "$(san "$5")" "$(san "$6")" "$(san "${7:-}")" >> "$TSV"
}
verdict_of() { # outfile target
  python3 - "$1" "$2" <<'PY'
import sys, os
out, target = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
def norm(p):
    p = p.strip().rstrip('/')
    return os.path.normpath(p) if p else ''
tn = norm(target)
found = None
try:
    fh = open(out, encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')
except FileNotFoundError:
    print('NO-OUTPUT'); sys.exit(0)
for line in fh:
    f = line.rstrip('\n').split('\t')
    if len(f) < 4:
        continue
    p = f[1].strip()
    if target == '':
        if p != '':
            continue
    elif norm(p) != tn:
        continue
    v = f[2].strip(); r = f[3].strip()
    found = v if v not in ('SAFE', 'NOT-SAFE') else (v + ('(%s)' % r if r else ''))
print(found if found is not None else 'NO-LINE')
PY
}
run_tool() { # out err ; args...  (shim-armed PATH; optional env prefixes from caller)
  local __o="$1" __e="$2"; shift 2
  set +e
  PATH="$SHIM:$SAFE_PATH" timeout "$T" bash "${RUN_TOOL:-$TOOL}" "$@" >"$__o" 2>"$__e"
  __rc=$?
  set -e
  echo "$__rc"
}
refsfp() { { git -C "$1" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null; git -C "$1" for-each-ref --format='%(refname) %(objectname)' 2>/dev/null; } | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1; }
porcfp() { git -C "$1" status --porcelain=v1 2>/dev/null | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1; }

FLEET=/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin
KT="$FLEET/kotodama-shokunin"

if [[ ! -f "$TOOL" ]]; then
  rec C00 "tool exists" exists "missing: $TOOL" 0 "ls -l $TOOL"
  exit 3
fi
TOOL_SHA="$(sha256sum "$TOOL" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
TOOL_BYTES="$(stat -c%s "$TOOL")"
[[ -x "$TOOL" ]] && TOOL_X=yes || TOOL_X=no
rec C00 "tool present at declared path" "regular file" "$TOOL ($TOOL_BYTES B) sha256=${TOOL_SHA:0:16}" 1 "ls -l $TOOL"
rec C00b "tool file is executable (runnable as tools/souji-verify.sh)" "mode +x" "executable=$TOOL_X" "$([[ $TOOL_X == yes ]] && echo 1 || echo 0)" "test -x $TOOL"

LANE_R0="$(refsfp "$REPO")"; FLEET_R0="$(refsfp "$FLEET")"; KT_R0="$(refsfp "$KT")"
LANE_P0="$(porcfp "$REPO")"; KT_P0="$(porcfp "$KT")"

if bash -n "$TOOL" 2>"$W/syntax.err"; then rec C01 "bash -n syntax" ok ok 1 "bash -n $TOOL"
else rec C01 "bash -n syntax" ok "FAIL: $(head -c200 "$W/syntax.err")" 0 "bash -n $TOOL"; fi

# ============ C02 --selftest (must cover F1-F10, exit 0) ============
rc="$(run_tool "$W/selftest.out" "$W/selftest.err" --selftest)"
sel_tail="$(tr '\n' '|' < "$W/selftest.out" | tail -c 220)"
[[ "$rc" == "0" ]] && st=1 || st=0
rec C02A "--selftest exit 0 (strict shim armed)" "exit 0" "exit $rc; stdout tail: $sel_tail; stderr: $(head -c 160 "$W/selftest.err")" "$st" "tools/souji-verify.sh --selftest"
set +e; PATH="$SAFE_PATH" timeout "$T" bash "$TOOL" --selftest >"$W/selftest2.out" 2>"$W/selftest2.err"; rc2=$?; set -e
[[ "$rc2" == "0" ]] && st=1 || st=0
rec C02D "--selftest exit 0 (shim disabled)" "exit 0" "exit $rc2; tail: $(tr '\n' '|' < "$W/selftest2.out" | tail -c 140)" "$st" "tools/souji-verify.sh --selftest (no shim)"
f_cases="$(grep -oE 'F1[0-9]?|F[0-9]' "$W/selftest.out" | sort -u -V | tr '\n' ',' || true)"
n_cases="$(grep -oE 'F1[0-9]?|F[0-9]' "$W/selftest.out" | sort -u | wc -l || true)"
[[ "$n_cases" -ge 10 ]] && st=1 || st=0
rec C02B "--selftest names all fixture cases F1-F10" ">=10 distinct F<n> labels" "n=$n_cases labels=$f_cases" "$st" "(stdout label scan)"
nfail="$(grep -cE 'FAIL' "$W/selftest.out" || true)"
[[ "${nfail:-0}" -eq 0 ]] && st=1 || st=0
rec C02C "--selftest reports no FAIL marker" "0 FAIL lines" "FAIL-lines=$nfail" "$st" "(stdout scan)"

# ============ C03/C04 usage -> exit 2 ============
rc="$(run_tool "$W/usage.out" "$W/usage.err" --bogus-flag /tmp)"; [[ "$rc" == "2" ]] && st=1 || st=0
rec C03 "unknown flag -> exit 2" "exit 2" "exit $rc" "$st" "souji-verify.sh --bogus-flag /tmp"
rc="$(run_tool "$W/usage2.out" "$W/usage2.err" --stale-days abc /tmp)"; [[ "$rc" == "2" ]] && st=1 || st=0
rec C04 "--stale-days abc -> exit 2" "exit 2" "exit $rc" "$st" "souji-verify.sh --stale-days abc /tmp"
rc="$(run_tool "$W/usage3.out" "$W/usage3.err")"; [[ "$rc" == "2" ]] && st=1 || st=0
rec C04b "no arguments at all -> exit 2 (usage)" "exit 2" "exit $rc" "$st" "souji-verify.sh"

# ============ Fixture A: pushed / local-only / D1 fallbacks ============
git init -q --bare "$W/fa/origin.git"
git init -q -b main "$W/fa/src"
printf 'a\n' > "$W/fa/src/a.txt"; git -C "$W/fa/src" add a.txt; git -C "$W/fa/src" commit -qm c1
printf 'b\n' > "$W/fa/src/b.txt"; git -C "$W/fa/src" add b.txt; git -C "$W/fa/src" commit -qm c2
git -C "$W/fa/src" remote add origin "$W/fa/origin.git"
git -C "$W/fa/src" push -q origin main
git -C "$W/fa/origin.git" symbolic-ref HEAD refs/heads/main
git clone -q "$W/fa/origin.git" "$W/fa/clone"
printf 'local\n' > "$W/fa/clone/local-only.txt"; git -C "$W/fa/clone" add local-only.txt; git -C "$W/fa/clone" commit -qm local
rc="$(run_tool "$W/fa.out" "$W/fa.err" "$W/fa/clone/a.txt" "$W/fa/clone/local-only.txt")"
v1="$(verdict_of "$W/fa.out" "$W/fa/clone/a.txt")"; v2="$(verdict_of "$W/fa.out" "$W/fa/clone/local-only.txt")"
[[ "$v1" == "SAFE(pushed)" ]] && st=1 || st=0
rec F1 "pushed file (origin/HEAD present) -> SAFE(pushed)" "SAFE(pushed)" "$v1; rc=$rc" "$st" "souji-verify.sh <clone>/a.txt"
[[ "$v2" == NOT-SAFE* ]] && st=1 || st=0
rec F2 "local-only introducing commit -> NOT-SAFE" "NOT-SAFE*" "$v2" "$st" "souji-verify.sh <clone>/local-only.txt"
git -C "$W/fa/clone" symbolic-ref -d refs/remotes/origin/HEAD
refs_n="$(git -C "$W/fa/clone" for-each-ref --format='%(refname)' refs/remotes/origin/ | wc -l)"
rc="$(run_tool "$W/f9.out" "$W/f9.err" "$W/fa/clone/a.txt")"
v="$(verdict_of "$W/f9.out" "$W/fa/clone/a.txt")"
[[ "$v" == "SAFE(pushed)" ]] && st=1 || st=0
rec F9 "origin/HEAD missing, 1 origin ref (n=$refs_n) -> SAFE(pushed) (D1)" "SAFE(pushed)" "$v; rc=$rc" "$st" "souji-verify.sh <clone>/a.txt"
git -C "$W/fa/clone" update-ref refs/remotes/origin/dev "$(git -C "$W/fa/clone" rev-parse HEAD~1)"
rc="$(run_tool "$W/d1.out" "$W/d1.err" "$W/fa/clone/a.txt")"
v="$(verdict_of "$W/d1.out" "$W/fa/clone/a.txt")"
[[ "$v" == "NOT-SAFE(pushed-unverifiable)" ]] && st=1 || st=0
rec C05 "2 origin refs, no origin/HEAD, no local master -> NOT-SAFE(pushed-unverifiable)" "NOT-SAFE(pushed-unverifiable)" "$v; rc=$rc" "$st" "souji-verify.sh <clone>/a.txt"

# ============ Fixture B: repo-root (kotodama-shaped) ============
git init -q --bare "$W/fb/origin.git"
git init -q -b main "$W/fb/src"
printf 'x\n' > "$W/fb/src/x.txt"; git -C "$W/fb/src" add x.txt; git -C "$W/fb/src" commit -qm c1
git -C "$W/fb/src" remote add origin "$W/fb/origin.git"; git -C "$W/fb/src" push -q origin main
git -C "$W/fb/origin.git" symbolic-ref HEAD refs/heads/main
printf 'y\n' > "$W/fb/src/y.txt"; git -C "$W/fb/src" add y.txt; git -C "$W/fb/src" commit -qm c2
printf 'dirty\n' >> "$W/fb/src/x.txt"
rc="$(run_tool "$W/fb.out" "$W/fb.err" "$W/fb/src")"
fline="$(head -1 "$W/fb.out")"
v="$(verdict_of "$W/fb.out" "$W/fb/src")"
ok=0; [[ "$v" == NOT-SAFE* ]] && ok=1
ev=0; [[ "$(printf '%s' "$fline" | tr '\t' ' ')" == *"unpushed=1 dirty=1"* ]] && ev=1
rec F3 "repo-root unpushed(1)+dirty(1) -> NOT-SAFE" "NOT-SAFE*" "$fline" "$ok" "souji-verify.sh $W/fb/src"
rec C06 "F3 evidence field carries unpushed=N dirty=M" "unpushed=1 dirty=1" "$(printf '%s' "$fline" | cut -f5)" "$ev" "(field 5 of the repo-root line)"

# ============ Fixture C: worktree registrations (F4/F5) ============
git init -q --bare "$W/fc/origin.git"
git init -q -b main "$W/fc/fake-shokunin"
printf 'r\n' > "$W/fc/fake-shokunin/r.txt"; git -C "$W/fc/fake-shokunin" add r.txt; git -C "$W/fc/fake-shokunin" commit -qm c1
git -C "$W/fc/fake-shokunin" remote add origin "$W/fc/origin.git"; git -C "$W/fc/fake-shokunin" push -q origin main
git -C "$W/fc/origin.git" symbolic-ref HEAD refs/heads/main
git -C "$W/fc/fake-shokunin" worktree add -q --detach "$W/fc/wt-absent"
rm -rf "$W/fc/wt-absent"
git -C "$W/fc/fake-shokunin" worktree add -q -b wt2 "$W/fc/wt2"
printf 'u\n' > "$W/fc/wt2/u.txt"; git -C "$W/fc/wt2" add u.txt; git -C "$W/fc/wt2" commit -qm unpushed
uniq_wt2="$(git -C "$W/fc/fake-shokunin" log --oneline wt2 --not --remotes | wc -l)"
mkdir -p "$W/fc/souji-shokunin/tools"; cp "$TOOL" "$W/fc/souji-shokunin/tools/souji-verify.sh"
rcP="$(RUN_TOOL="$W/fc/souji-shokunin/tools/souji-verify.sh" SHOKUNIN_ROOT="$W/fc" run_tool "$W/fcP.out" "$W/fcP.err" "$W/fc/wt-absent" "$W/fc/wt2")"
v1P="$(verdict_of "$W/fcP.out" "$W/fc/wt-absent")"; v2P="$(verdict_of "$W/fcP.out" "$W/fc/wt2")"
if [[ "$v1P" != "SAFE(metadata-prune)" || "$v2P" != "NOT-SAFE(unpushed-branch)" ]]; then
  rcQ="$(SHOKUNIN_ROOT="$W/fc" run_tool "$W/fc.out" "$W/fc.err" "$W/fc/wt-absent" "$W/fc/wt2")"
else
  rcQ=-; cp "$W/fcP.out" "$W/fc.out"; cp "$W/fcP.err" "$W/fc.err"
fi
v1="$(verdict_of "$W/fc.out" "$W/fc/wt-absent")"; v2="$(verdict_of "$W/fc.out" "$W/fc/wt2")"
[[ "$v1" == "SAFE(metadata-prune)" ]] && st=1 || st=0
rec F4 "worktree reg, dir absent, unique=0 -> SAFE(metadata-prune)" "SAFE(metadata-prune)" "$v1; rc=$rcP (tool-copy+SHOKUNIN_ROOT); fallback rc=$rcQ" "$st" "SHOKUNIN_ROOT=$W/fc souji-verify.sh $W/fc/wt-absent"
[[ "$v2" == "NOT-SAFE(unpushed-branch)" ]] && st=1 || st=0
rec F5 "worktree reg, named branch, unpushed=$uniq_wt2 -> NOT-SAFE(unpushed-branch)" "NOT-SAFE(unpushed-branch)" "$v2; rc=$rcP; fallback rc=$rcQ" "$st" "SHOKUNIN_ROOT=$W/fc souji-verify.sh $W/fc/wt2"

# ============ Fixture D: ledger (F6) — two placements ============
mkdir -p "$W/fd/souji-shokunin/corpus/knowledge" "$W/fd/vault/kept"
git init -q "$W/fd/souji-shokunin"
printf 'preserved payload\n' > "$W/fd/souji-shokunin/kept-note.md"
cp "$W/fd/souji-shokunin/kept-note.md" "$W/fd/vault/kept/kept-note.md"
src_sha="$(sha256sum "$W/fd/souji-shokunin/kept-note.md" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
vlt_sha="$(sha256sum "$W/fd/vault/kept/kept-note.md" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
LGR_ENV="$W/fd/ledger.tsv"; LGR_ROOT="$W/fd/souji-shokunin/corpus/knowledge/obsidian-ledger.tsv"
